rules.note: Upload the passport information page. The passport must be valid beyond March 1, 2027; renew it first if not.
Not listed in the official requirements.
Highest degree certificate. If you have not graduated yet, upload a pre-graduation or student status certificate; the original or notarised degree certificate is due by registration.
Transcripts for both your master's and bachelor's studies. If you are still studying, upload transcripts up to your current stage.
Language proficiency certificate meeting ZJU's language requirements for international graduate applicants.
Personal statement in Chinese or English, at least 1,500 words: study and work background, reasons for applying and your study proposal.
Two letters, in principle from full or associate professors in your field. Each must show the professor's signature, phone number and email.
ZJU Supervisor Provisional Acceptance Form (2026 version), filled in by the supervisor. Required only if your programme's catalogue entry asks for it.
Published papers or other academic achievements, if you have them.
Foreigner Physical Examination Form, fully completed, with the doctor's signature, hospital stamp and sealed photo. Valid for 6 months. Needed for the CSC Type B route.
Non-criminal record certificate from the local public security authority, issued within 6 months before you apply. Needed for the CSC Type B route.

Hand-signed ZJU Commitments form (PDF). Former Chinese citizens or people born abroad to a Chinese parent also upload the nationality documents named in the guide. Non-English/Chinese papers need notarised translations.
